clause_review.description: Verify that your contract covers all mandatory processor requirements under GDPR Article 28(3).

documented_instructions.label: Documented Instructions
documented_instructions.description: Process data only on written instructions from the controller.

confidentiality.label: Personnel Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Ensure staff authorised to process data are committed to confidentiality.

security_measures.label: Security Measures
security_measures.description: Implement technical and organisational security measures (Art. 32).

sub_processor_restrictions.label: Sub-processor Restrictions
sub_processor_restrictions.description: Engage sub-processors only with prior specific or general authorisation.

data_subject_rights.label: Data Subject Rights Assistance

security_breach_dpia.label: Breach & DPIA Assistance
security_breach_dpia.description: Assist the controller with breach notifications, security audits, and DPIAs.

deletion_on_termination.label: Deletion or Return of Data
deletion_on_termination.description: Delete or return all personal data at the choice of the controller after processing ends.

audit_rights.label: Audits and Inspections
audit_rights.description: Allow for and contribute to audits and inspections conducted by the controller.

review.warning_body: Objecting to a sub-processor change is a legally significant action under the GDPR. Under your DPA terms, you may have the right to terminate the agreement. Review your DPA clause coverage for termination provisions.

step1.title: Step 1: Transfer Details
step1.subtitle: Identify the specific parameters of the international data transfer.
step1.us_context: Since the invalidation of the Privacy Shield, transfers to the US using SCCs require a TIA to assess risks associated with FISA 702 and EO 12333.

step2.title: Step 2: Legal Assessment
step2.subtitle: Assess the laws and practices of the third country applicable to the transferred data.
step2.surveillance: Are there surveillance laws that compel access to the data?
step2.remedies: Are there effective, enforceable legal remedies for data subjects?
step2.equivalent: Laws provide essentially equivalent protection (no supplementary measures needed)
step2.not_equivalent: Laws do not provide essentially equivalent protection

step3.title: Step 3: Supplementary Measures
step3.subtitle: Identify the supplementary measures implemented by the data importer to mitigate risks.
step3.not_required: Based on Step 2, supplementary measures are not strictly required. You can skip to the Conclusion.

measures.staff_training: Staff trained on handling authority requests
measures.onward_transfer_controls: Controls on onward transfers to sub-processors
measures.notify_access_requests: Commitment to notify the exporter of access requests

step4.title: Step 4: Residual Risk
step4.subtitle: Assess the risk level after applying all supplementary measures.
step4.justification_placeholder: Explain why the residual risk is acceptable or unacceptable…

incidents.title: Breach & Regulatory Intelligence
incidents.subtitle: Alerts, GDPR enforcement fines, and data breach updates tracked for this vendor.
incidents.empty_body: No data breaches, fines, or regulatory actions have been detected for this vendor.
incidents.art33_body: If this breach affects personal data you shared with this vendor, you may need to notify your supervisory authority within 72 hours under Article 33. Review the breach details above and assess whether your data subjects are affected.
incidents.action_required: Action required: review security incident alert
incidents.notes_placeholder: Document your action notes, e.g. 'Confirmed no data subjects are affected by the API key disclosure.'

relationship.title: Relationship record
relationship.purpose_placeholder: Why this vendor processes personal data for us
relationship.deletion_certificate_hint: The reference of the confirmation that data was deleted or returned at the end of processing.
relationship.joint_controller_hint: A joint controller needs an Article 26 arrangement, not a DPA. The Article 28(3) clause checklist does not apply.
relationship.category_limit: A vendor can record at most {max} data categories.
relationship.category_special_note: This vendor receives special category data (Article 9). A DPA and a documented Article 9(2) condition are required.
relationship.review_never: This relationship has never been formally reviewed.
relationship.unlink_title: Remove this vendor from your register?
relationship.unlink_body: Offboarding keeps the record as evidence of a processor you used. Removing deletes it.
relationship.unlink_evidence: This relationship holds {count} records that would be destroyed: assessments, questionnaires, sub-processor changes and transfer assessments.
relationship.unlink_confirm: Delete the relationship and its evidence

history.description: Every change to this vendor, who made it and when. Sourced from the organisation audit log.
